episodeTitle.en: Unpacking Amazon’s unique ways of working | Bill Carr (author of Working Backwards)
episodeTitle.zh: 解读亚马逊独特的运营方式 | 比尔·卡尔（Bill Carr，《倒退工作法》作者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Bill Carr is the co-author of Working Backwards: Insights, Stories, and Secrets from Inside Amazon. With a background at Amazon of over 15 years, Bill played a pivotal role in shaping the company’s global digital music and video ventures, including Amazon Music, Prime Video, and Amazon Studios. After Amazon, Bill was an Executive in Residence with Maveron, an early-stage, consumer-only venture capital firm. He later served as the chief operating officer of OfferUp, the largest mobile marketplace for local buyers and sellers in the U.S. Today he’s the co-founder of Working Backwards LLC, where he helps companies implement Amazon’s time-tested management strategies. In this episode, we discuss: • What exactly “working backwards” is, and how you do it
guestBioOfficial.zh: 比尔·卡尔（Bill Carr）是《倒退工作法》（Working Backwards）的合著者。他在亚马逊任职超过15年，曾深度参与亚马逊全球数字音乐和视频业务的布局，包括亚马逊音乐、Prime视频和亚马逊影业。离开亚马逊后，比尔在早期消费级风险投资公司Maveron担任驻场高管，随后担任美国最大的本地买卖双方移动市场OfferUp的首席运营官。如今，他是Working Backwards LLC的联合创始人，致力于帮助企业实施亚马逊久经考验的管理策略。本期节目讨论议题：• 何为“倒退工作法”及其具体实践

title.en: Unpacking Amazon’s unique ways of working | Bill Carr (author of Working Backwards)
title.zh: 解读亚马逊独特的运营方式 | 比尔·卡尔（Bill Carr，《倒退工作法》作者）

summary.en: Bill Carr distills the operating system behind Amazon's success: working backwards from customer needs (via the PR/FAQ process), single-threaded leaders who own outcomes with dedicated cross-functional resources, and input metrics that drive long-term outputs. He explains why 'disagree and commit' hinges on being heard and then committing with understanding, how a product 'funnel' of PR/FAQs selects the best ideas, and how Amazon's stock-based comp and CEO-backed structures let it tolerate failure and innovate. He also details the Bar Raiser hiring practice and the 'slow is smooth, smooth is fast' mindset.
summary.zh: Bill Carr 提炼了亚马逊成功背后的操作系统：从客户需求倒推（通过 PR/FAQ 流程）、拥有结果并配备专门跨职能资源的单一负责人、以及驱动长期输出的输入指标。他解释了为什么“提出异议并承诺执行”关键在于“被听到、然后带着理解去承诺”，PR/FAQ 的“产品漏斗”如何筛出最好的想法，以及亚马逊基于股票的薪酬和 CEO 背书的结构如何让它容忍失败并创新。他还详述了 Bar Raiser 招聘实践和“慢就是顺、顺就是快”的心智模式。
